# GCP Agent Trace Evaluation — Executive Dashboard

Project: `scalkit` · Region: `us-east1` · Online evaluator: `132574714030718976` · All quality scores are percentages · Management pass target: **80%**.

2.title: Safety quality (%)
2.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) and evaluation.source_name == "safety_v1" | dedup evaluation.result_id | summarize quality_percent = avg(toDouble(evaluation.score)) * 100

3.title: Hallucination quality (%)
3.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) and evaluation.source_name == "hallucination_v1" | dedup evaluation.result_id | summarize quality_percent = avg(toDouble(evaluation.score)) * 100

4.title: Overall trace quality (%)
4.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | summarize quality_percent = avg(toDouble(evaluation.score)) * 100

5.title: Quality trends (%)
5.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | makeTimeseries average_score = avg(toDouble(evaluation.score)), by:{evaluation.source_name}, interval:10m | fieldsAdd quality_percent = average_score * 100 | fieldsRemove average_score

6.title: Recent trace evaluation results
6.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | fields timestamp, evaluation.conversation_id, evaluation.source_name, score_percent=toDouble(evaluation.score) * 100, evaluation.agent_resource | sort timestamp desc | limit 100

7.title: Pass rate ≥80%
7.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | summarize total=count(), passing=countIf(toDouble(evaluation.score) >= 0.8) | fields pass_rate_percent = 100.0 * passing / total

8.title: Evaluation results
8.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | summarize evaluation_results = count()

9.title: Conversations evaluated
9.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | summarize conversations_evaluated = countDistinct(evaluation.conversation_id)

10.title: Below target (<80%)
10.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) and toDouble(evaluation.score) < 0.8 | dedup evaluation.result_id | summarize below_target_results = count()

11.title: Quality comparison by metric (%)
11.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | summarize quality_percent=avg(toDouble(evaluation.score))*100, by:{evaluation.source_name} | sort quality_percent desc

12.title: Evaluation mix
12.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | summarize results=count(), by:{evaluation.source_name}

13.title: Target attainment
13.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | fieldsAdd target_status=if(toDouble(evaluation.score)>=0.8,"Meets target",else:"Below target") | summarize results=count(), by:{target_status}

14.title: Score distribution
14.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | fieldsAdd score_band=if(toDouble(evaluation.score)>=0.8,"80–100%",else:if(toDouble(evaluation.score)>=0.5,"50–79%",else:"Below 50%")) | summarize results=count(), by:{score_band}

15.title: Evaluation volume over time
15.query: fetch logs | filter gcp.project.id == "scalkit" and evaluation.online_evaluator_id == "132574714030718976" and isNotNull(evaluation.result_id) | dedup evaluation.result_id | makeTimeseries evaluation_results=count(), interval:10m
